headline: Swedbank shares fall 4.3% as third-quarter earnings miss estimates
summary: Swedbank reported third-quarter 2026 earnings that missed analyst estimates, sending its shares down 4.3%.
why: Quarterly earnings reports from major Nordic financial institutions provide insight into regional credit quality, net interest margins, and consumer banking health.

impacts.name: Swedbank
impacts.why: Weaker-than-expected Q3 earnings results directly led to a 4.3% decline in the bank's share price.

why_moved: Disappointing financial results relative to consensus analyst expectations triggered negative investor sentiment and selling pressure.
